text_block_list.text:
A cold winter night. Midnight before the 
Arima Kinen. Hearing a rustling noise, I 
opened my eyes to see—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, you're awake! My dear guinea 
pig."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't look so surprised. Breaking in at 
night technically violates the rules. I 
doubt you want to be punished either.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're slow on the uptake. Let me ask you 
instead: what day is it today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're right, but you're wrong. It's 
Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so, here is a present! Merry 
Christmas, my guinea pig!

Rarely has anything good ever come from 
accepting something from her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What's with that face? Aren't you happy?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I went through all the trouble of 
preparing this just to bridge the 
psychological distance between us, you 
know?

"...It was suspicious, but if it really 
was a genuine gift, acting rashly might 
break our trust."

Opening the package revealed a small drink 
bottle inside.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's Tachyon's special Energy Drink! Drink 
this, and you'll feel a hundred times more 
energetic!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're a hardworking member of society, 
too. I figured the fatigue must be piling 
up for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, chug it down! Bottoms 
up!

Whenever she made drinks—my body would 
glow yellowish-green, my hair would turn 
light blue... Nothing good ever came of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! But I put so much love into making 
this! I even went out of my way to order 
ginseng all the way from the Chugoku 
region, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's disappointing that my sincerity 
didn't reach you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, with the way I've acted up until 
now, perhaps I deserve to be treated like 
the boy who cried wolf.
choice_data_list:
(T-Tachyon has such a sad look on her 
face...!)

text_block_list.text:
My heart ached seeing her look so 
downcast, so I threw caution to the wind 
and took a sip.
—However.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, hahahaha! Just how long do you 
intend to keep your eyes shut?

Nothing happened. In fact, quite the 
opposite—
choice_data_list: I feel like my fatigue just vanished...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Told you, it's just an energy drink. I 
wouldn't pull any nasty pranks on such an 
auspicious day."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to express my gratitude to 
you. On a day like today, at least."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, there is no need to linger. I 
must head back and get some sleep as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well then... look forward to today's Arima 
Kinen.

With those words, she jumped out the 
window and vanished.

The sweet aftertaste lingering on my 
tongue and the cool breeze blowing in 
through the window were surprisingly 
gentle and comforting.

Opening the package revealed an aroma 
candle inside.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's an aroma candle specially made by 
Agnes Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The 1/f fluctuation of fire is well-known, 
but pleasant aromas also have positive 
effects on the mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Specifically for this occasion, in 
addition to lavender and neroli essential 
oils for their relaxing effects, I took 
the liberty of borrowing a scent from your 
personal life that suits your tastes—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, in short, it's a fine present. Now 
then, light it up!"
Hurried along, I lit the fire. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho, what a nice aroma—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—I'm not smelling that at all. It smells 
sour, salty, bitter, and spicy, doesn't 
it!?

An outrageous, pungent odor filled the 
entire room!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! My goodness, forgive me! I 
completely forgot about the test!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, this won't do at all! What a 
stench! Temporary tactical retreat! Run, 
Guinea Pig-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Heh heh, hehehe, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That really panicked me for the first 
time in a while! What was with that 
apocalyptic smell?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I thought I concocted it well, but... I 
really shouldn't dabble in things I'm not 
used to.

Whatever the method, it was abundantly 
clear that she had prepared this with all 
her heart.
choice_data_list: It really is the thought that counts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. As softhearted as ever, I see. Though 
from my perspective, it leaves me a bit 
unsatisfied.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
When the goal you've been aiming for 
cannot be achieved, frustration builds up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, it doesn't even have to be a 
physical item. Gratitude can be expressed 
in words rather than gifts.

Just as she seemed to come to a conclusion 
on her own, she turned back toward me with 
a composed expression.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I am always grateful to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not trying to make fun of you or 
anything—

After saying all that, she awkwardly 
looked away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hold on a second. This is way 
more embarrassing than I imagined.

Catching a glimpse of a rare side of her, 
I felt as though we had grown just a 
little closer.
